Package model.independent

Class CyclicAccessList<T>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.ArrayDeque<T>
model.independent.CyclicAccessList<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type contained in the list.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<T>, Collection<T>, Deque<T>, Queue<T>
public class CyclicAccessList<T> extends ArrayDeque<T>
A list that is cyclic, holds it's own current position which can be iterated and that can export a variable length section centered around its current position, the middle of the list.
